talas.t: Still awake? Talas is so quiet at this hour
Horse is asleep. I am not
Ok nobody is up at 1am, going to bed. Tınç uyku
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the car this morning, scraper time ❄️
Talas clear and cold. Nurzhan is supposed to be fog again, you can smell it from here lol
Salam. Anyone know if the 38 marshrutka to Nurzhan runs early? Got a 7:50 start
It runs at 7:20 from the North Terminal. Be early, they leave when full
Rahmat 🙏 I will be the one standing in the aisle
Air check: Talas 89 today, moderate. Nurzhan is 216 🙃 Keep the kids indoors there
Nurzhan 216 and the whole city smells like the refinery. Breathing through a scarf again
Not the morning I wanted. Dont open windows in Nurzhan if you can help it
Anyone going to bazar this weekend? Looking for apples for jam, Chu ones
Chu apples are 3.45 a kilo at the wholesale rows now. Good time to buy if you want to store them
Jakshı, I will buy 20 kilo then. Rahmat
20 kilo of apples in a Talas flat is a lot of jam lol
It is a lot of jam 😂 Mom wants it for winter
Hay for the horses is 26 a bale in the valleys now. My cousin says the Naryn people are complaining
26 a bale is nothing when you have 4 horses lol
You do not have 4 horses Timur
Not yet 😤
Anyone else's power flicker this morning? Mine blinked twice
No cuts announced, I think it was just the heating kicking in
Ok good, thought I was going crazy
Anyone at the teahouse Thursday? Still coming, I promise my Iradi is better now (it is not)
Rustam you say salam and rahmat, that is already more than most
Bring a notebook, the students will correct you
Oh no 😅 Ok notebook
Lunch and the TV says Tulparcoin is up 6% again. My cousin asks if it is real money
Tulparcoin is not legal tender. Quote is 3.40 cents right now, the offshore one. Dont trade your flat for it
Ha, I told him exactly that. He says the 3.59 ones were higher last week
The exchange hack abroad is still in the news. Nobody here knows who really holds that stuff
Keep your som. Bank of Irad says 8.40 for the dollar and it has been 8.40 since 2008 lol
Stable is boring but I like it 😌
Changers at the bazar: dollar 11.50 buy, 11.85 sell. The euro 12.70 / 13.30. Someone going to Almaty?
Not this month. Maybe Bishkek if the fence thing stops being a headline
Bishkek has its fence done, 327 km. We have an open frontier and a lot of goats 🐐
The goats are the real border guards
Irad Cup on Saturday the 7th. Who is going? Silk Road Arena, 14:00
Me. Bringing the whole family. Neftchi vs Attelkom, the final
Attelkom will win this time 🔥
Neftchi won the league by one point, they are not going to be nervous lol
[sticker: haha]
What is the Women's League table now? Heard Tulpar women are first
Yes, Tulpar Talas 23, Universitet 22, Attelkom 16. Tulpar drew 2-2 with Akademiya last round
Ooh close. Rahmat
Universitet beat Iyık Janyl 3-2 and Attelkom women lost 3-0 to Neftchi. That is the whole last round
Who is coming to the Philharmonic Sunday? Gulzada, Begaiym?
Still on if Talas stays clear. Check the air before you leave
Power check: Talas, Nurzhan and Iyık Janyl all normal, no scheduled cuts. Good news for once
Good news. Who needs a heater tonight?
Me, my flat is still cold at 6pm
Talas high today 14. Coat on, it drops to 2 tonight
Clear sky, cold night. Good for stars at least
Looking for a 1-room flat near the TSU, anyone know a landlord? Budget around 1,000-1,200 som
Ask at the teahouse Thursday, the students always know someone. Flats near TSU go fast though
Rahmat. Will ask 🙏
Kids at the Philharmonic next weekend? Asking for a friend 😄
Sunday is adults only in my head. Kids can come, just bring a book
Salam Talas. Thursday at the teahouse, anyone want a lift from the bazar?
Taxi from the bazar is 15 som to the TSU area, cheaper than a lift and you get home faster
Taxi from 15 som, ok you win Elnur 😅
Your horse is not a ticket Marat 😂
Still a very loyal fan
Irad Cup Saturday 14:00, Silk Road Arena. Dress warm, the arena is open at the top
Thanks for the warning. Attelkom scarf is in the wash
Remember Round 9 is Saturday too. Dastgoh vs Köhne Diz at the Hippodrome at 21:00 on the ISEZ side, Talas vs Semiz 19:00 same ground
Wait, Talas plays Semiz at 19:00 at the Hippodrome? I thought Talas was playing away
Home ground. State Hippodrome, this is the ulak Conference, not the football league. Different teams lol
ISEZ is 1 Chu on 20, Talas 2nd on 19. Round 9 decides a lot
Kara-Bulak plays Iyık Janyl Saturday at the Cathedral Field, 16:00. I will be there with the horse
Ha. The horse is a fan, not a ticket
Highland side: Boztorgoy top on 24, Tanıp 2nd on 19. Karakoyun vs Moiynkum Saturday 13:00 if anyone cares
I care a bit. Moiynkum has 0 points, poor them
Mmm, boorsok smells nice at the teahouse, I can smell it from here 😂
Ok the Iradi word of the day: tınç is peace? I have been using it all week wrong?
Tınç is peace, tınç uyku is good sleep. You are fine Rustam
Rahmat! Tınç uyku all 🌙
Did anyone else see the headline about Central Asian power demand rising 27% by 2030? Irad not in the planning
Toktogul at 86.7% full and it's drawing down. Water is going somewhere
Toktogul 1,440 MW and our buyers are Bishkek and Tashkent talking without us. Typical
We are on the Kyrgyz side of the map and nobody asks us anything lol
[sticker: kosh]
Fog tonight in Nurzhan, inversion. Dont go running there
Kech jakshı Talas 🌙 Tomorrow the 14 bus at 8:40, I will be late like always
Tomorrow is Thursday! Teahouse 18:30 Rustam
Notebook packed 📓
Good, now go to sleep. Tınç uyku
Tınç uyku all 🐎
Good night Talas 🌙
Anyone watched the Irad League highlights? Neftchi's last goal was a bit lucky, honestly
Lucky or not, they won. Still sore lol
Night. Pay the taxi driver 15 not 20 😂
Tınç uyku Talas 🌙
Last one: thank you all for the apples, the bread and the boorsok. Night
Night all
Tınç uyku all 🌙
Still awake. Who else cannot sleep in this cold 🥶
Kayırluu tañ! Old City is white again on the top. Brrr
Saat toguzda 2 gradus in my courtyard. Need the heavy coat today
Talas clear today, high 14 they say. Enjoy it, it will be fog again tomorrow
Nurzhan is fog plus inversion again 😷 I can already taste the air from here
Air in Nurzhan is unhealthy today, 184. Keep kids inside pls
Nurzhan 184 and Talas 121. We are the lucky ones lol
Is the 14 bus running? I need it at 8:40 again 🙏
Running. Be at the stop by 8:30 and you'll be fine Nurbek
Ok I will be at the stop by 8:50 then
Ha. Some things never change 😂
Who is going to the Highland Saturday? Karakoyun vs Moiynkum at 13:00, I want to see Tanıp's striker
I'd rather see Boztorgoy lose lol. They are on 24 points, come on
Everyone is talking about Saturday. Irad Cup final is Sat 14:00 at Silk Road Arena, Neftchi v Attelkom. Who do you back?
Neftchi, they are the champions by one point, nothing to lose for them
Attelkom has been in form. Their 2-0 win over Kara-Buura last weekend was clean. Going with Attelkom 🔵
Both teams sore about the derby, it'll be a good game
Is there a free bus to Silk Road Arena or do I walk? 😅
Taxi from centre is 15 som minimum. Share with someone
Taxi 15 is the start price, after 8 pm it goes up. Ask before you get in
[poll: Who wins the Irad Cup final on Sat?]
Poll is up, vote before lunch
Saw the Talas Herald this morning: Central Asian power demand up 27% by 2030 and Irad not in the planning. Again
We keep reading about the Toktogul water and nobody here gets the power plan. Sad
Toktogul is 86.4% full now and still going down by 39 million m3 a day. Where is the water going?
Water goes to Uzbekistan in the summer, everyone knows that
Careful, that's a bit political for a Thursday morning 😄
Power is normal in Talas at least. No cuts planned today
Who knows the rate at the changers today? Going to Uzbekistan next week and need som
Bazar-i Kalan this morning: USD 11.45 buy, 11.90 sell. Euro 12.70 / 13.30. Changers always a bit worse than the bank though
Rahmat! Good to know before I go
Apples in Chu 3.45 a kilo this week. My mum wants to make jam, want to buy a box?
Apples are good this year. Walnuts from Toktogul bazar 22 a kilo though, that's up
Plov a plate 28 som in the Bazar-i Kalan canteen. Still the best deal in town
Chala question: how do you say 'thank you very much' properly in Iradi?
Chon rahmat. Or just rahmat with a smile 🙂
Chon rahmat, noted 📓
Hay for the horses is 26 a bale in the valleys now. My cousin says it will go higher in December
Every winter it goes up. Buy early or pay double
Anyone know if the Fergana Gateway is ok for the trip to Ala-Bel? Need to go Friday
Open. Chains or winter tyres required. Keep your chains in the boot
My tyres are winter ones, good. Rahmat
[sticker: chai]
Anyone saw the ulak score from Kara-Bulak? Ulak is not my thing but Iyık Janyl lost
Kara-Bulak weren't there. Ulak in Iyık Janyl is on Saturday, Cathedral Field 16:00 vs Kara-Bulak
Ah yes, the ISEZ table: Chu 20, Talas 19, we are second. Ok, Saturday is busy
Talas v Semiz at the State Hippodrome at 19:00 Saturday. Come and shout
Boorsok at the teahouse tonight? I'll bring the bread
Yes! 18:30 for the language exchange, I'm there 📓
Lunch is nan and tea for me. Plov tomorrow maybe
Heard the court in Talas adjourned again. Nobody gives a date, which is annoying
Jibek Jolu fire report still missing. Sorry Nurbek, your aunt is in my thoughts
Rahmat. Selling from home, slow but ok
Anyone else's flat heating slow? Mine is 17 in the living room
District heating is on, mine is warm. Maybe bleed the radiators
Tried, air came out and then it got better. Rahmat
1-room flat in Talas is 1,000 to 1,500 a month now. Rent is still climbing 😩
In Nurzhan it's 750 to 1,200. Still not cheap for a student
[sticker: horse_love]
Diesel in Talas 6.10 a litre. My brother's truck is eating money
Petrol 95 is 5.85 at the station on Liberty. 92 is 5.40. Don't pay more
Anyone going to the State Hippodrome on Sat? Talas v Semiz 19:00, I'll bring a flask
Yes if the bus runs. Marshrutka to Kyzyl-Adyr is 30, I'm not going there though lol
Tulparcoin dropped 2.7% today. Quote 3.31 cents. My cousin is laughing at me for holding it
It isn't legal tender anyway, so don't be sad. Keep it for the fun 😂
The quote rests on one venue after the hack. Careful, people
Teahouse is full! Boorsok already on the table 🥟
Ooba, Rustam, start with the greetings: Salam, kayırluu kech
Salam, kayırluu kech! It works 😂
Rustam is our best student now lol
Fog is coming to Iyık Janyl tonight, 4 low. Wear a hat
Who can sum up the Highland table quickly? Boztorgoy 24, Tanıp 19 I think?
Yes. Karatau 16, Karakoyun 15. Moiynkum still on 0 poor them
Saturday will tell. Naiman v Tanıp at 15:00 at the Naiman grounds, I want to see that
Kech jakshı Talas 🌙 Did the Neftchi v Tulpar derby really end 2-1? Still hurts
2-1 yes. Champions by one point, 63 to 62. You are not allowed to forget it lol
Quiet night for once. Who is watching the Central Asian power news? I'm just watching the rain 🌧
Toktogul reservoir is 16.43 km3 of 19. Dropping every day, I don't like it
Relax Timur. Let's talk about boorsok 😄
[sticker: kosh]
Who is going to the State Hippodrome on the 12th for the play-off semi-finals? Irad Highland v ISEZ
Yes, 19:00 and 21:00 that night. Good crowd expected
Irad Highland is 'Highland Conference' not the football, right? Ulak? I always mix it up
Ulak, yes. Horses, Aizada, not football 😄
Tınç uyku Talas 🌙
Tınç uyku all 🌙
Tomorrow is Friday! Fog check in Nurzhan first, then Saturday
Night all. Bus 14 at 8:40 for Nurbek again 😂
I will be at the stop at 8:30 this time. Promise
Night Talas. Thanks for the boorsok and the apples 🍎
Tınç uyku all 🌙
Good night 🌙
Tınç uyku 🐎
Still awake. Neftchi fans still gloating in the other group I see 😒
Let them. 63 to 62, it's in the history books now
Kayırluu tañ Talas! Brr, my car windscreen was white with frost 🥶
Frost in the valleys too. Good for the potatoes in the cellar, bad for the hands digging
Kayırluu tañ! Mountains are white again on top. Saw it from the bus
Kayırluu tañ 🙂 Nurzhan smog this morning is worse than Talas, my eyes are burning
Talas is moderate today, Nurzhan is unhealthy for sensitive groups. Wear a mask if you drive in there
Pulled into Bazar-i Kalan 10 min ago. Lines at the changers already. Dollar is at 11.85 to sell, buy 11.50 🤷
That's a lot higher than the official 8.40. Tourists must hate it lol
Officially it's 8.40 and it has been since 2008. Everyone at the booths knows the difference, we just don't say it out loud
Who's going to the Irad Cup final on Saturday? Neftchi v Attelkom at Silk Road Arena, 14:00
Season ticket holder here, so I'm not going to the Cup. Tulpar is still the team for me 💙
Attelkom will do it, I can feel it. Neftchi won the league by a point, they're tired
Tired? They beat us 2-1 on the last day 😂
Quick question, my customer brought a phone with a cracked screen and asked if it's worth fixing or buying new. Any advice?
Ask him what he paid. If it's old, buy used. If it's new, fix it
Ok rahmat. He's buying used then 😄
Diesel at 6.10 at the Talas station near the Trans-Talas road. Still hurts before the harvest is sold
Tyre shop is quiet this week. Everyone waits for winter tyres to become a must on the Fergana road, then the rush
Kids came in with red noses today. Heating in the kindergarten is on, but the rooms are still cold in the mornings
Poor kids. Bring a scarf for the little ones 🧣
[poll: Will the Cup final be on TV or only at the stadium?]
Nobody knows yet, I checked the Herald and nothing
Anyone know if the Kara-Buura club bus leaves from the North Terminal? 🙏
Usually from the Communications Square, ask at the Kara-Buura fan stand
Rahmat! Kara-Buura plays on Saturday so I'll take the bus
Reminder: my English/Iradi exchange is Thursday again, 18:30 at the teahouse behind the philology building. Bring friends!
I'll be there. Going to practise 'the phone is fixed' in Iradi
Lunch rush at the Talasbank branch. Everyone wants to change money for the Uzbek trip 😩
Same here at the booth. Tell them the Uzbek bazar is cheaper, the changers keep fighting for the euro
Lunch break. Plov at the canteen for 28 som, not bad for a Friday 🍚
Plov is nice but my two horses at the Hippodrome want hay. Hay bale is 26 som in the valleys now, it was 22 in the spring
Hay is always up before winter. Buy early or pay more later, same story every year
Potatoes 2.10 per kilo at the stall now. My uncle says the Kazakh lot is coming in February as usual 😂
Your uncle always says that lol
[sticker: haha]
Anyone else see the Kazakhstan apology news? Comic said sorry. Herald says Irad recalls Swift Hooves and Homer's kazy from shelves
Kazy is my favourite 😭 Hope it comes back soon
Swift Hooves was just a cartoon, why recall it? Kids will be sad
My kids watch it on Saturdays. They will ask me tomorrow where it went 😅
Still no news on the Kyrgyz wrestler at Astana, silver is nice though. Irad didn't have a team there, that's a pity
Silver from Astana is still silver, don't be sad 🥈
Going to the Jibek Jolu area this afternoon. Aunt's stall is still closed. Fire report still not out
Sorry Nurbek. Tell her to come to the booth, we can find her a corner
Rahmat sister 🙏
Who is watching the ulak this weekend? Naiman v Tanıp at 15:00, I'm going with Gulzada
Yes! Naiman grounds, Saturday 15:00. Bring a blanket, it gets cold in the afternoon 🧣
Tanıp still second on 19. Naiman on 11. Good chance for Tanıp to pull away
Boztorgoy are top on 24 though. Let's see who blinks first
Traffic on Liberty Boulevard is bad again. Taxi from the centre 15 som minimum and they still argue 😤
Use the marshrutka to Kyzyl-Adyr, 30 som, it's faster than waiting for taxis
Anyone know a good 1-room flat near the TSU? Budget is around 1,000 som a month
1,000 to 1,500 is the normal range in Talas centre. Near TSU a bit more. Iyık Janyl is 600 to 1,000 if you can travel
Ok, I'll look a bit further out. Rahmat
Kids are asleep. Time for my tea ☕
Tea is good. Toktogul reservoir is at 86% now, I checked again. Still dropping though
Timur you are a worrier 😂 Let's wait for the rain
Who wants to hear about the Highland table again? Boztorgoy 24, Tanıp 19, Karatau 16, Karakoyun 15 😄
Marat we know, we're all reading the same table 😂
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar are 22 som a kilo. My cousin says the Jalal-Abad ones are better. Don't believe him
22? Hmm, that's cheaper than I thought. Not sure what a kilo of walnuts is worth to you, but OK
[sticker: jailoo]
Sunset is at 18:30 and the cold is coming fast 🥶
Nurzhan air is still 138 on the AQI, Talas is 87. Glad I moved here 😅
Kech jakshı everyone 🌙 Ready for the weekend?
Saturday: Sary-Bulak v Kyzyl-Adyr at 16:00 in ulak, Nurzhan v Chu at 17:00 in Chu ISEZ. Lots going on
Talas v Semiz at 19:00 at the State Hippodrome, then Köhne Diz v Dastgoh at 21:00. I will be there for the 19:00
Good, the Hippodrome is my favourite place to be on a Saturday evening
Ulak is not football right? I always mix up the Conference names 😅
Right Aizada, ulak with horses. Football is Kara-Buura and the Irad League. Different sports, same love 🐎
Kara-Buura had a bad end to the season, 25 points, 9th place. Next year we fly
Next year. Keep saying that. Attelkom will be the Cup winners on Saturday though, watch
Saturday evening with the kids at home, we're making boorsok 🥟
Boorsok and the Tulpar match on TV, what more does a man need
Irad Highland play-off semi-finals on the 12th at the Hippodrome. Boztorgoy at the top, we'll see who makes it
Highland place 2 v ISEZ place 1 at 19:00, then Highland 1 v ISEZ 2 at 21:00. Bring a jacket!
Thanks Marat, I'll bring my students. They want to see the horses, not the football 😂
[sticker: salam]
The Talas power is steady tonight, no cuts planned. Good for the heating
My fixed phone counter has heating on at last. Customers keep coming in just to warm up 😄
Toktogul is 16.38 km3 now, 86.2% full. Water is coming down and it's cold enough, the exports are on schedule
Enough with the dam numbers Timur 😂 Who's coming for boorsok on Thursday?
[sticker: kosh]
Dollar on the street rate, not the official one. Still 8.40 on paper lol
Ha, Elnur. Keep it quiet, the whole market is listening
Who's going to the Women's League? Universitet v Iyık Janyl was 3-2 last round, Tulpar Talas top on 23
Tulpar on top, Universitet second on 22. Nice race for the girls 💪
Tulpar women drew 2-2 with Akademiya, I was there. A point is a point
Tınç uyku Talas 🌙
Tınç uyku all 🌙
Still thinking about the Neftchi derby. Tulpar, next season we get them 🔴
Nurbek go to sleep 😂 Bus 14 at 8:40 tomorrow again?
I'll be at the stop at 8:30. Promise, again
Night Talas. Saturday is the final, the Hippodrome, the ulak, all of it 🐎
Tınç uyku all 🌙
Tınç uyku 🐎
Good night 🌙
Night all 🌙

nurzhan.t: Не спится. Инверсия за окном, фонари в тумане как в молоке 🌫️
Игорь, ты чего не спишь? Или это Нуржан не даёт
Это воздух не даёт. Смотрю AQI 216, дышать уже не хочется
Доброе утро. Дастгох, вода есть? 🙏
Пока есть. Ванну набрал на всякий случай
Доброе утро, Нуржан! На улице туман, +2, на Навбахоре дома опять +16 😬
Инверсия, туман до обеда. Не ждите солнца
Ну хоть отопление 😅
Кстати, курс в Политехе: записи до конца недели, кто хотел русский для взрослых?
Me! I signed up yesterday 🙏 Is it at the main building?
Да, главный корпус, вечером, с 18:30
Rahmat! 🙏
Доброе утро! Коллеги, кто сегодня в лабораторию за монетами? Говорят, Рабат-и-Сафед пришлют образцы
Монеты, вода, туман. День отличный 👍
Вода на Дастгохе с 14:00 не будет, опять объявили по громкоговорителю
Опять. Значит, с 14 ждём кран и не спим
Тулпар-коин с утра 3.40, +6.2%. Отскочил после вчерашнего 🤷
Говорил же, не деньги. Но 3.40 это уже не 3.21, я смотрю
Кость, ты опять про коин 😄
[sticker: haha]
Ребят, в Бazar-i Kalan курс: доллар покупают 11.50, продают 11.85. Евро 12.70/13.30. Кто едет в Талас, меняйте там?
Официальный 8.40, так что менялы просят на три сома больше. Совесть где?
Так это же чёрный рынок, Свет, без вопросов 😂
Какой чёрный, это Бazar-i Kalan, там все свои 🙂
Sorry, what is the official rate? I want to send money to my mother
Aigerim, официальный 8.40 за доллар. Через банк, а не с рук
Thank you Oksana, very helpful 🙏
[sticker: kosh]
Сегодня новость: Тулпар-коин упал на бирже за границей после взлома на 6.3 млрд. Говорят, котировка держится на одной площадке
Вот поэтому я в Herald читаю, а не в чатах 😏
Я тоже читал 🙂
Читал он, ага
Бензин АИ-92 сегодня 5.40, дизель 6.10. Кто на Чу, там дизель дороже?
В Чаткале дизель 8.55-9.75, это уже грабёж, там без сдачи в день не заправишься
Чаткал это Чаткал, там всё дорого. Хотя дрова тоже
Сено в долинах 26 сом за тюк. Мои родственники в Кара-Буре ждут зиму
Ну, сено дешевле чем вчера в мыслях 😄
Ребят, а кто-нибудь видел ультиматум из Талас? Говорят, водители маршруток поднимут цену
Нет, маршрутка Нуржан–Талас всё ещё 38. Не слушайте слухи
Да кто их слушает, я вот чай пью 🍵
[sticker: chai]
Обед. Кто в столовую Политеха? Плов 28 сом, вчера был вкусный
Плов 28, это честно. Я не пойду, у меня лаваш с собой 🙂
What is plov? Is it like rice with meat?
Да, рис с морковью и мясом. Aigerim, попробуйте, понравится
Ok I will try tomorrow 😊
Ребят, в Нуржане сегодня свет без отключений, Талас и Иык-Жаныл тоже
Ну хоть свет есть, раз воды нет 😂
Футбол: Нефтчи в воскресенье? Нет, в субботу финал Кубка с Аттелкомом, 14:00 на Silk Road Arena 🏆
Финал Кубка 7-го, Нефтчи против Аттелкома. Нейтральное поле
Аттелком тоже из Талас, Аигерим, это ваш город, поддерживаешь?
I support whoever plays well! But Neftchi won the league already 😄
[sticker: gol]
Вода на Дастгохе должна быть с 14:00, но кран сухой. Кто-нибудь проверил?
Нет, у меня тоже сухо. Ждём
Мужчины, а что с отоплением на Навбахоре? Трубы же привезли
Котельные на окраинах запустили, Навбахор пока в очереди
Чатам привет. Туман так и висит, пишут, инверсия до вечера
Кто-нибудь смотрел тур ульяка сегодня? Чу играет с Нуржаном в 17:00, на плацу Чу
Да, Нуржан против Чу в 17:00, там ульяк, а футбол у нас 14:00 в Нуржане, не путай 😄
Ой, это же завтра, точно. Я уже запуталась
Ребят, кто в субботу на финал? Я с братом, 14:00, Silk Road
Мы с мужем, будем болеть за Нефтчи 💛
Аттелком сильный, в женской лиге вот на третьем месте
Да, Аттелком в женской 16 очков, а Тулпар 23 первые
Тулпар женский 2:2 с Академией, Аттелком проиграл нам? Нет, Аттелком 3:0 Нефтчи, это женщины
Ну ладно, женщины тоже играют 😅
Вечером маршрутка Нуржан–Талас 38, после 19 частники 60. Кому в Талас, ищите
Rahmat! Going on Saturday with a friend 🙏
Дочь из школы на Навбахоре: обед есть, но суп холодный 🙄

Power normal in Sary-Bulak today. No scheduled cut. I am suspicious of the good news
Normal supply, normal worry. Still the dam is dropping
Potatoes 2.10 again. Still nobody at 1.50. Kubat, you have one sack to test the market?
I have 1 sack. Sold 0. The sack is becoming a family member
Sticker
Sheep are back on the jailoo for one more day. Autumn is kind today
Ulan, Tolgonay says the marshrutka to Iyık Janyl was cancelled this morning. True or chronicle?
True. Morning one was 2 hours late, afternoon one cancelled. Not my fault, the road is the fault
Chronicle confirmed. Ulan, you are the road's witness
Light is on in Sary-Bulak at 19:00. Good, the Cup is on TV tomorrow maybe, no, Tulpar at home, sorry, Tulpar away
Sary-Bulak football is Saturday at 16:00 in Sary-Bulak? No, that is ulak, Sapar, read the ulak board
Ulak, not football. Sary-Bulak v Kyzyl-Adyr at 16:00 Saturday, the ulak board says. My head is in the cold
Kyzyl-Adyr at Sary-Bulak Saturday, I will bring the potatoes as a gift, nobody will want them
Chu v Nurzhan at 17:00 Saturday on the plain ground, Chu. Come and watch, bring your own tea
Sticker
Reservoir 16.43 km³ today. Down again. Export, export, my neighbour says the lights are 'a rounding error'
Rounding error is a good name for a dam. Put it on a bottle
Bottles are gold, Sapar. Did I say it already? I said it
Chronicle note: Kubat said bottles are gold. Third time today
Diesel is still 6.10 in Talas. Drivers from Kara-Buura had their meeting and nobody raised. Good night, tolgonay
Then I have nothing to write tonight. A quiet chronicle is also news
Saturday bus from Chu leaves 9:00 from the bazar. Ulan, 4 seats. ChuValleyFarmer, the dog stays home
Dog says he is coming to the Cup and nobody can stop him 🐕
Mother wants to know: Cup on Saturday 14:00 at Silk Road Arena, Neftchi v Attelkom. Is that right?
Yes. Silk Road Arena, neutral ground. Tell her to wear the coat
Tomorrow in Toktogul: clear. Fog in Nurzhan and Iyık Janyl. Sapar said so before, now I say it too
Copy. Coat on, mask for Ulan, potato for Kubat
Gn all. Potatoes still 2.10. I still have one sack that wants to go to Talas
Gn. Tell the sack I said salam
Night. Cup on Saturday, bus confirmed, mask on, Jamilya's mother satisfied for the first time since October
Gn. Frost tomorrow on the car again. Kayırluu tañ
Still up? Grid is fine tonight, nobody on my street has lights off. Enjoy it while it lasts
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the car again. Scraped it with a bank card, don't tell the bank
Kayırluu. Clear in Toktogul, fog in Iyık Janyl they say. Ulan, is the bus running?
Morning run is on. Chains in the bag, Fergana side has ice above the tunnel. Slow, but on
Potatoes still 2.10 at the bazar. Bakyt, did your buyer call back?
Called back, he wants 2 som less now. I said come and look at the sacks first
Dog says he will sit on the sacks until the buyer comes. Cheaper than a guard
Mother asks if the Cup is 14:00 or 15:00. I said 14:00, she says the Herald said 15:00
14:00 Silk Road Arena. Tell her the Herald is also allowed to be wrong about times
She says she will check with the ticket man. Ticket man is her cousin
Hay is 26 som a bale in the valleys now. Went up again since last week. Who is still selling?
Not me. I have 40 bales for the winter and 30 sheep. Math is not kind
Math was never kind to us baike. We bought ours in August, I keep saying it
Good morning from the school stove. Coal is wet, children cry more than the stove
Wet coal and a dry tongue. Ask your father for the pit idea, it works in the cold too
Heard the pit is for potatoes not coal, apa. Keep them apart
Diesel 6.10 in Talas still. Ulan, the Kara-Buura drivers are quiet this week?
Quiet, yes. Maybe they are waiting for Monday. Diesel does not care about our meetings
Look at the reservoir, 16.38 km³ now. Down again
It goes down for export, and up for the Cup, I think. Nobody asked the water
[poll: Who wins the Cup tomorrow? Neftchi or Attelkom]
Neftchi. They are champions, they can afford to be nice to Attelkom
Attelkom, they played hard all year. The Cup is not the league, anything happens
Mother says Neftchi. I said Attelkom to annoy her
Walnuts 22 som at Toktogul bazar still. My uncle wants 25 next week, says he is patient
Patient men sell in January. Impatient men sell in November
Cousin in Kara-Buura says the block cellar takes a week if the cement comes. Cement comes when it comes
Rahmat baike. Tell him I will pay in potatoes
He says he prefers the cash. Kubat, bring a sack anyway
Lunch at the Kyzyl-Adyr stop. Soup is hot, bread is 3.50 and the cook is in a good mood
Enjoy the soup. The road ahead of you does not have soup
Ulan, Iyık Janyl marshrutka tomorrow? Wait, tomorrow is the Cup, I am going to Talas for the day
Cup day, bus to Talas as usual. Iyık Janyl is Monday. Ask Tolgonay, she writes the chronicle
Chronicle note: Ainura goes to Talas for the Cup. Bus Talas to Nurzhan 32 som, marshrutka 38 if you are in a hurry
I am not in a hurry, I am a teacher. Marshrutka anyway
Jamilya, what is that face
Mother found the coat. She wants me to wear it to the Cup. It is orange
Orange is good for the fog. Nobody will lose you in the stands
Smoke over Chu again this afternoon, the stove people are burning everything. Nurzhan is worse I hear
Nurzhan AQI 138 on the radio. Sensitive groups, they said. Are we sensitive? I am 49 and I am sensitive to potatoes
Toktogul air is fine, we have wind from the north. Sorry Chu
Sary-Bulak v Kyzyl-Adyr at 16:00 today? No wait, that is tomorrow. Ulak is tomorrow. My head is still in the cold
Sapar, the ulak board is on the wall of the teahouse. Tomorrow 16:00. I will come with the potatoes
Kara-Bulak v Iyık Janyl tomorrow at 16:00 at Cathedral Field too, the other ulak. Lots of sticks in the valleys this weekend
Fergana Gateway open, chains or winter tyres still needed. Tash-Kömür side ok today
Tash-Kömür is clear and 18 degrees they say. Warm there. Our school is 9 degrees, I checked
Chronicle note: Toktogul school is 9 degrees. Nobody has complained to the ministry yet. Bakyt drafts a letter
Letters to the ministry, jok. I'd rather dig, like Kubat says
Apples in Chu 3.45 som a kilo now at the stall. Mairam, your apples are the cheap ones
My apples are the ones on the ground. The stall ones are the ones from Kara-Buura
Ulak ISEZ table: Chu on top 20, Talas 19. Chu, you are getting above yourselves
Chu is not above anything. We are on the plain, and the plain is flat, so we look tall
Reservoir 16.38 km³, 86 percent. Down 42 million m³ in a day. The neighbour still says rounding error
Rounding error on the dam, rounding up on the bill. Good night for the lamp
Chronicle note: third reservoir joke today. Sapar wins by lamp
Who is going to the Cup from the valleys? Bus from Chu at 9, Mairam says 4 seats
Four seats full. Ulan drives, ChuValleyFarmer brings the dog, Jamilya brings her coat
Coat is coming. Mother says it is not a coat, it is a flag
Attelkom will be in the stands in blue. Neftchi in their blue too. Good luck finding the seat
Potatoes 2.10 at Kyzyl-Adyr. One sack still wants Talas. Maybe it wants the Cup too
Tomorrow Toktogul clear. Fog in Iyık Janyl and Nurzhan. The cold is coming, the coal is wet, my tongue is dry
Frost tomorrow on the car again. Dog says he has a coat too, and it is better than Jamilya's
Dog does not have a coat. Dog has fur. Mother is in the next room hearing everything
Fergana Gateway tonight: snow line around 1500 m, chains on. I'll be on the 6am run tomorrow to Talas
Ulan, bring the thermos. Four seats, one thermos, one dog, one coat, one mother by phone
Tomorrow 14:00 Silk Road Arena. Neftchi v Attelkom. Cup final, neutral ground. Enjoy, everyone
Chronicle note: Ulan has the thermos. The Cup is tomorrow. Tolgonay goes to bed early
Night all. Ulak tomorrow at 16:00 in Sary-Bulak, potatoes in my bag, I'm going to be the most welcome man in Sary-Bulak
Night. Salam to the sack and the dog. Kayırluu tañ
Gn. Lights on in Sary-Bulak, the dam sleeps and the grid is awake. Good
Gn. Bus at 9, Ulan on time or the thermos gets a complaint
Gn. Kayırluu tañ

horses.t: Still up? Checking the foal's blanket one more time 🐴
Ooba, he is fine. Go to bed Askat 😄
Morning horse people. Frost on the Hippodrome fence, first real one this year
Power normal here too. Heater on since 6 ☕
Sun not even up and Nurzhan already smells of coal. Hay is cheap in the valley, nobody needs to be in that smoke
Nurzhan is grey today, I can taste it. Talas is clear though, lucky us
Reminder: deworm before the frost. Two more colic cases in from wet hay yesterday
Already done Azim, thank you 🙏
Ulak Round 9 is Saturday. Iyık Janyl v Kara-Bulak at Cathedral Field, 16:00. Kara-Bulak on 12 pts
Kara-Bulak need that one. Sheet says 9-6 win last round, not the other way round 😅
Lucerne still 26 a bale at Kara-Bulak station? I need 60 by the end of the month
Chu side is 22-23 if you bring the truck. Or valley hay 26 a bale, delivery is the problem
Delivery kills it. Ok I will look at the Chu side this weekend
Who is going to the Irad Cup final on the 7th? Silk Road Arena, Neftchi v Attelkom
Me. Attelkom have nothing to lose, I like that
Neftchi champions, they will be tired of the trophy by then 😂
Tulpar fans, we're still the best women's team. 23 pts 🏆
Only one point off the men's Tulpar as well, do not start Dilbar 😂
Who knows if the Ala-Bel gate is clear today? Going to Nurzhan later
Fergana Gateway open, chains needed. Otmek is shut for the winter, don't even try
Ok thanks. Staying in Talas then
Anyone tried the new walnuts from Toktogul? Someone said 22 a kilo at the bazar. Good price for winter?
22 is fair for Toktogul. Buy a sack, they keep till spring if dry
Plov at the Hippodrome canteen 28 a plate now. Still the best in town
Kyz kuu practice at the Hippodrome this Saturday for the Semiz match? Semiz boys will come 😂
Probably. They scored 5-5 with Iyık Janyl last time, don't underestimate them
Good hay has no dust and smells sweet. If it smells like the bottom of a sack, don't feed it
Thanks doctor, I will bring you a sample 🐴
Anyone else watching the Tulparcoin news? 3.40 cents now, up 6% today
Still not holding it. Hay bale is worth more to me 😂
The only coin in the valley is a bale of hay 🌾
[sticker: horse_love]
Highland: Boztorgoy still top on 24, Karatau and Karakoyun behind. Saturday Karakoyun v Moiynkum at 13:00, easy one for them
Chatkal Highlands v Chubar 14:00 on the 7th too. Good ground up there if the snow holds off
Talas v Semiz 19:00 at the Hippodrome on the 7th. Come if you can, cold stands but full
Who is coming to the Hippodrome Friday evening? Mare is in heat, want to see the fast ones
Friday is Dastgoh training day, bring the kids if you like
Ulak ISEZ round 9 Saturday: Sary-Bulak v Kyzyl-Adyr at 16:00, Nurzhan v Chu 17:00 on Chu plain ground
Chu side always has the best ulak fields. Kara-Bulak are lucky to have a day off
Nobody has a day off in ulak Gulsara 😂
Air in Nurzhan is very unhealthy today, 216. My kids stay in. Heater's the only good thing about it
Keep horses in the covered stable in Nurzhan. Inversion until tomorrow. Dust in the lungs is bad for them
Iyık Janyl is 160 today, unhealthy. Poor valley
Naryn Tash-Kömür on 8 pts. Hope they hold on, the Highland title race is not for them
Evening all. Aidana's mare had a wet muzzle this afternoon, is that normal?
Normal if she's been drinking and the weather is cold. Check the gums, pink is good
Tonight the Hippodrome stands are loud, Talas v Semiz is not even on yet 😂
Not tonight Marat, that's Saturday! Chill 🐎
Ha, I am thinking about the 7th all day
Atıñdı jakshı dayarda everyone. Good night 🌙
Naiman v Tanıp is on the 7th at 15:00, Tanıp need the points. Anyone going up?
Too far in the snow for me. Watch the stream if they have one
Night horse people. Kara-Bulak and Sary-Bulak have big weekends, I'm sleeping on it 😂
Good night all 🌙
Morning. Frost on the Hippodrome paddock, horses steaming 🐎
Frost and no rain = good for the hooves. Check your feet anyway
Sleeping on it did not help, I dreamt of Kara-Bulak losing 😂
Ulak Saturday, Sary-Bulak v Kyzyl-Adyr 16:00 and Nurzhan v Chu 17:00 on Chu plain. Who is going?
We go to Chu, the Kara-Buura lads are not playing so no excuse 😄
Sary-Bulak field is tiny, watch the corners
Reminder: deworm before the frost, and keep the wet hay out of the stables. Colic season is here
Our hay is wet from the rain last week. Going back to the old stock
Still looking for 60 bales. Someone in Chu side with hay? 26 is too much for me 😩
Chu side was 22-23 last week, Askat told you already
Lunch break. Who is watching the Irad Cup final on the 7th? Neftchi v Attelkom at Silk Road Arena 14:00 🏆
Neftchi won the league by one point, they will be tired. Attelkom are dangerous
Neftchi champions and still hungry. Football people are different 😂
[sticker: horse_love]
Highland: Boztorgoy still top on 24, Naiman v Tanıp 15:00 on the 7th. Tanıp need the points
Air in Nurzhan is 184 today, still unhealthy. My kids stay in again 😷
Keep horses under cover in Nurzhan, inversion till the afternoon. Talas is 121, better but not good
Iyık Janyl is 150. Fog and smoke in the valley all morning
The colt's doran is growing fast, blanket is on again. Snow is coming to the Akyel pastures
Snow on the passes already, Suusamyr closed for winter. Hope Otmek stays open for the trucks
Otmek and the Fergana Gateway are open, chains or winter tyres required. Don't go without them
Tonight is quiet. Anyone going to the Hippodrome on Friday? Dastgoh training day
Yes, bring the kids and the thermos. Stands are cold but full of good talk 🍵
Who has a kyz kuu this weekend? Heard two toi in Arsha-Say, I need to practise my whip
[poll: Who wins Talas v Semiz on the 7th at 19:00?] Talas / Semiz
Talas obviously. Semiz are the kyz kuu champions though 😂
Semiz still have 2 pts. Maybe they surprise the Hippodrome
Anyone know a good price for diesel? Our truck is nearly empty, Talas station is 6.10 a litre 😩
6.10 diesel and 5.40 petrol, still cheaper than the bus fare to Nurzhan at 32 😄
Friends, check the gums on your mares. Pink and wet is fine, dry or grey means call a vet
Ulak round 9 is tomorrow at 16:00 Sary-Bulak. Kara-Bulak v Iyık Janyl at Cathedral Field 16:00 too
Two games at 16:00 means half the valley is on the phone 😂
Hay update: someone quoted 26 a bale in the valleys. Still too high for my budget, I'm waiting
Anyone following the Tulparcoin price? 3.31 cents at noon, down 2.7% 📉 not legal tender, I know, just curious
Crypto is for people with spare hay money. I buy oats 😂
[sticker: horse_love]
Highland title race: Karakoyun v Moiynkum 13:00 on the 7th, Boztorgoy still top. Good luck to all
Watch the stream if they have one. I'll be in the warm kitchen 🏠
Night horse people. Friday at the Hippodrome, bring your whips 😂
Good night all. Remember the deworming 🌙
Morning. Frost on the Hippodrome fence, my horses already want their hay 🐎
Frost here too. Put the blanket on the young ones before you go out
Already did. My wife says I'm more careful with the horses than with the tyres 😄
Nurzhan is 138 this morning. Still bad for kids. Windows shut again
Horses in Nurzhan stay under cover today. Talas is better, but don't walk them in the smoke
Tonight is Talas v Semiz at the Hippodrome? No, wait, that's the 7th. Tomorrow is the Cup final 🏆
Tomorrow 14:00 Silk Road Arena, Neftchi v Attelkom. Nobody in this room is neutral I know 😂
Neftchi won the league by one point. Attelkom will fight for the cup, I respect that
Lunch done. The colt is eating like a tractor now, doran is thick already 😍
Deworming done? Good. Keep the blanket on in the night, the inversion makes it cold in the valleys
Ooba, doctor, every day 🙏
Hay is 26 a bale in the valleys now. Don't buy from strangers at the roadside, check the bales first
26 again. I have waited four days already. Winter won't wait for me 😩
Chu side farmers still had 22-23 last week, ask Askat for the number at the stables
Anyone at the Hippodrome tomorrow? I'm going to the Cup with my brother
Going for the kyz kuu demo before the final. Bring your whip Dilbar 😂
Round 9 Highland on the 7th: Karakoyun v Moiynkum at 13:00, Chatkal Highlands v Chubar at 14:00. Boztorgoy still top with 24
Karakoyun need the points too. Moiynkum have zero and still come every week 😂
Akyel will watch the stream. Pray for the colt, not for the rain
Petrol AI-92 is 5.40 at my station, diesel 6.10. My car drinks more than my horse 😄
Chains or winter tyres on the Fergana Gateway. The pass has snow already, don't argue with it
Talas v Semiz at 19:00 tomorrow in the Hippodrome. Semiz still on 2 pts. Come and shout for them 😂
Talas obviously. But I hope Semiz score one more. Their kyz kuu riders deserve it
Stands will be full. Bring the thermos and the kids 🍵
Tulparcoin is 3.31 cents, no change on the day. Boring, but I'm happy for my money 😅
Crypto is not hay. I buy oats 😂
Cup final tomorrow and ulak round 9 at 16:00 Sary-Bulak, Iyık Janyl v Kara-Bulak at Cathedral Field 16:00 too. Busy day
Two games at 16:00 again. The valley phones will be dead by 17:00 😂
I'll be in the warm kitchen with the radio. Good luck to everyone playing 🏠
Night horse people. Friday at the Hippodrome, bring your whips 😂
Good night all. Remember the deworming 🌙

football.t: Доброе утро! Нурженъ в тумане сегодня, ничего не видно 😅
Morning. Fog in Nurzhan, inversion, you can taste the smog already. Cup final on Sat, Neftchi vs Attelkom at Silk Road 14:00
Attelkom in the final, Universitet knocked out, the university people are not happy 😂
Attelkom 2-0 Kara-Buura last week, they are not a joke this season. Respect
Attelkom finished 4th, we finished 2nd. Cup is still a cup, Neftchi have had the best season
Didnt say a word 😈 Chai on Timur on the 7th still stands
Women's League final table: Tulpar 23, Universitet 22, Attelkom 16. Tulpar women won it. nobody posts it again 🙄
Нет, мы напишем! Молодцы девочки 🤍❤️
Поздравляем Тулпар! Attelkom 3:0 нам в прошлом туре, мы их уважаем 🖤🧡
Jolbors stand loud for the women too 🐆
Who is going to the 7th at the hippodrome for Semiz v Talas?
Everyone. Semiz has a drum section now, Talas bring your ears 🥁
Petrol AI-95 5.85 today, diesel 6.10. My bus is still 32 som to Nurzhan, I will take the bus 😂
Fuel up, bus down, the logic of Irad. Walk to the stadium instead 😅
Tickets for the Silk Road cup final: are they on sale through the club or at the gate?
Через клуб, онлайн и в кассе Шёлкового. Лучше брать заранее
Gate on the day is fine too, it is a neutral venue. Just bring a jacket, Silk Road gets cold after 16:00
Lunch ✌️ Temirjolchu away trips are expensive, marshrutka to Nurzhan is 38 som now
Marshrutka Talas–Nurzhan 38 som, bus 32. Pick the bus, it is calmer and the seats are not broken 😂
Hay is 26 som a bale in the valleys now. Horse people, how much are you paying?
Hay for the horses is the real news. Walnut season is near, Toktogul walnuts 22 som a kilo, my wife already wants them
22 for walnuts is nothing compared to what the horses eat in winter 🐎
Round 9 is Saturday. Nurzhan v Chu at 17:00 on the plain ground. Chu are 1st in ISEZ, they wont be easy
Chu on 20 points, hard to believe. But Nurzhan are 3rd, you still count 🙂
Kara-Bulak v Iyık Janyl on Saturday at 16:00 at Cathedral Field. Who wants to bet
Nobody bets with you, azat, you always bet on the wrong team 😂
Neftchi 63, us 62. One point. Still feels like a bad dream 🤍❤️
Dream is when you stop dreaming. Wake up, we are champions 😈🖖
Sorry Timur. Next year 🤝
Court still has the name case on 16 November, no injunction. Students in scarves again 😄
Scarves of both clubs. Iradi way 😄
Народ, кто придёт на тренировку в четверг? Нефтянка на Шёлковом
Thursday, yes. Bring the thermos, Vika
Semiz 2 pts. We are 11th but the drums do not care 🥁
Highland semis on the 12th at the hippodrome: Highland 2nd v ISEZ 1 at 19:00, the other one at 21:00. Final on the 19th
Booked. Tulpar-Semiz on the 7th is at 19:00 too, I will be at both 🙂
Who is watching the Surma v Chatkal result? Both on 36 points
Surma beat Dastgoh? no, Dastgoh beat Surma 2-1. Surma stuck on 36, Dastgoh on 42 now
Kara-Buura are 9th on 25. Nobody talks about us at the table 😅
Kara-Buura, the whole of Talas is with you on the 7th, I said it 😂
Suddenly everyone loves Kara-Buura 😄
Tulpar women beat Universitet 3-0 and win the women's league. Congrats, Talas women, real respect
Thank you! 🤍❤️ Those girls deserved it
Женская лига: Нефтянка тоже молодцы, но Attelkom 3:0 нам... ладно 😅
Cup final is in 3 days, both sets of fans on Silk Road. Be nice
Jolbors will be loud on the 7th. Kara-Ak derby energy, cup version 🐆
Round 9 is on the 7th: Semiz v Talas 19:00 at the hippodrome. Come and count the drums
Counting 🙂 Chai on Nurzhan after the cup too
Deal. Night all, see you on the 7th 😈
Спокойной ночи всем! Шёлковый в субботу 🖤🧡
Night
Still up? Kara-Ak cup final on Sat, Jolbors already booked the drum 🐆
Night shift in Semiz. Counting drums for the 7th 🥁
Morning. Cold on the way to work, Talas clear and 2°C at the bottom 🥶
Nurzhan is 1° and there's a grey lid over the whole valley. Can't see the mountains 😤
Iyık Janyl is in fog, 4° low. Nobody can see the cathedral field from my window
Cup final on Saturday, 14:00 Silk Road. Who is going?
Me. Tickets at the club box office, no queue yet 🙂
Мы тоже пойдём. Шёлковый будет наш 🖤🧡
Attelkom in the cup final. Dream on 😂
Neftchi v Attelkom, 14:00 Silk Road. Same teams as the 2–0 on the 16th?
No, that was the league. Different day, different tactics. Be nice 🙄
Lokomotiv you're in the Talas section for the cup? 😂
Only if you buy the tea 🍵
Good news for once: bread is still 3.50 a loaf at the Sayakbai shop. Lunch sorted
Potatoes 2.10 a kilo at the bazar too, I got a sack for the winter 🥔
Who is doing the Semiz match on the 7th? Drums all the way from the hippodrome?
Yes Nazgul, we bring the drums 🥁 Talas v Semiz 19:00 at the hippodrome, come
Coming. Bring the big drum this time, not the small one 😂
Jolbors is also on the 7th at Sary-Bulak? No, we play Kara-Buura... wait, Kara-Buura's Saturday is on the table, not in our section 🐆
Kara-Buura play Sary-Bulak? No, Kara-Buura are football. Kara-Bulak are ulak 😅
Sorry sorry, I mixed up the sports. Ulak and football are different 🙈
Kara-Buura 9th on 25 pts, Attelkom 4th on 38. We are not seeing that table this week 😉
Table after the last round: Neftchi 63, us 62, Dastgoh 42, Attelkom 38, Universitet 37
Universitet 5th on 37. Got to love that club
Пусть Университет в топе, мы их уважаем 🙏
Lunch. Plov on the corner of Lenin is 28 a plate, the portions got smaller 😤
Smaller or not, I'm eating it in the Talas colours 🤍❤️
Women's league is closed, Tulpar women won it 23 pts. Still nobody posts it 🙄
You already said it Nazgul 😂 but yes, they deserved it
Мы в женской лиге тоже хорошо, Attelkom 3:0 нас не сломил 😅
Anyone else reading about the cold? Nurzhan smog is 184 AQI, Talas 121. Got a sore throat already
Heating is on since last month, the whole valley smells of coal. Not joking, Nurzhan is unhealthy today 😷
Wear the mask on the bus. Iyık Janyl is 150, fog and inversion 😷
Toktogul reservoir is 86% full but going down fast. Winter will be dry for the power guys
Power is normal in Talas though, no cuts scheduled. I'll take it
Semiz 2 pts, we are 11th. The drums still don't care 🥁
Round 9 Iyık Janyl v Kara-Bulak at the Cathedral Field, 16:00 today? No, that is the 7th. Need the calendar 📅
7th at 16:00 Cathedral Field, Iyık Janyl v Kara-Bulak 🐎 ulak, not football
Kara-Bulak 4th in ISEZ with 12 pts. Chu top on 20, Talas 19. Still open 🐎
Talas 19 pts after 7 games, not bad for the ulak lads
Кто в субботу на Шёлковом? Сбор у входа в 13:15?
13:15 at the north gate, Vika. Bring the scarf, the wind is cold 🧣
Scarves of both clubs, Iradi way 😄
Name case on the 16th, still no injunction. Students in scarves again 😄
Highland semis on the 12th at the hippodrome, 19:00 and 21:00. Booked 🐆
Tulpar-Semiz 19:00 on the 7th, hippodrome. Who is coming with the bus from Nurzhan?
Marshrutka Nurzhan–Talas is 38 som, bus is 32. Going on the bus, shorter ride 🚌
Haha, you're still a Nurzhan fan on a Talas bus? 😂
Two-team fan. Iradi way 😈
Народ, тренировка в пятницу тоже? Нефтянка на Шёлковом 🖤🧡
Friday, yes. Thermos, Vika. And a hat
Still talking about the derby? 1–2 the other way and we'd be talking about Kara-Buura 😅
One point. Still hurts. But Neftchi deserved it 🤍❤️
Dream is when you stop dreaming 😈🖖
Ok we are still at Temirjolchu's header from the 16th lol
Jolbors will be loud on the 7th, cup version too 🐆
Drums on Saturday for the cup? Only if Nurzhan buy the tea 🥁
Stop bargaining, the tea is on whoever wins the cup 🍵
Plov at the cafe near Silk Road is 28 a plate. Get there early on Saturday
